Strategy: Split residuals at thirty instead of fifty: roomy bins compete by worst fit while tight bins compete by best fit, with exact fits always winning. This lowers the roomy threshold so the switch engages more often, but it may preserve tight bins too aggressively and waste space.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else ((r - item) if r - item >= 30 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
